item.title: Taking a purposeful bite out of domestic violence
item.description: Help Now of Osceola County, the area’s advocacy group for domestic violence victims and survivors, held its annual “Tapas With a Purpose” fundraising gala Saturday at Osceola Heritage Park. Donors came to sample incredible food offerings from local chefs and caterers tapas style— in small, shareable portions—and to bid on silent auction items ranging from art to family game-night packs to ticket packages for theme parks and local sports teams.
